evidence: decorative_mascot: hook@0.3 to seg1:start: Data slides up the bars doing a generic dance pose. seg2:start and seg3:start–end: he stands on top of a bubble. seg1:mid/end: he waves off to the side. His act is never tied to a stat.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: hook@0.3 to seg1:start: a standard horizontal bar chart where the bars GROW to 99.3%/98.9%/94.1%/87.5%, and the kicker reads 'RACCOONS PULLS AHEAD'. A 99% collapse is drawn as a winning race.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The rank/bar chart kind was picked instead of a loss relationship. Bars filling toward 99% say 'more', the opposite of a population that vanished.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show the collapse as disappearance. For example, a field of 100 raccoon silhouettes (and opossums, deer, bobcats) that blink out until 1 remains, with a python shape sliding through. Drop the 'pulls ahead' kicker and have Data react to the emptied field.
